 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. S.D. Sanjay, Sr. Advocate
 Mr. Lokesh Kumar, Advocate
 Mr. Vishal Kumar, Advocate
 Mrs. Sushmita Mishra, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Raj Kishore Roy, Gp-18
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order

4 07-05-2024 Heard Mr. S.D Sanjay, learned Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned AC to GP-18.
2.

The present writ petition has been preferred for the grant of following relief/s:-
"to issue writ in the nature of mandamus for a direction to the respondents prohibiting them for constructing of Namami Ganga Priyojana/Udbhaw Ganga Pariyojna, on the land of petitioner without acquisition of land under Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
(ii) to direct the respondents to acquire the land of petitioner and after making payment of compensation at the rate of market value equal to acquired land Patna High Court CWJC No.14927 of 2022(4) dt.07-05-2024 appertaining to Mauza-Kurka,
P.S. Buniyadganj, District-Gaya, Tahan No. 249, Khata N. 114, Plot No. 11 and 12 out of total area 22 acres through due process of law.

(iii) To grant any other appropriate relief/reliefs as your lordships may deem fit and proper for the end of justice."
3.

Learned Senior counsel for the petitioner submits that he has got title over the land and the State of Bihar having lost the battle preferred Second Appeal No. 74 of 2016 which is pending before the Arvind Kumar Jain vs The State Of Bihar on 7 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187015783/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Patna High Court.

4. His submission is that for the present, he has got title over the land on which under Namami Ganga Priyojana/Udbhaw Ganga Pariyojna, the pipelines have been inserted without any notice and/or compensating for it.

A supplementary-affidavit of the year 2022 is on record and learned Senior counsel wants incorporation of paragraph-5 which reads as follows:
"5.

That the total land of the petitioner under which the respondents have constructed underground pipe during ganga Udbhaw Pariyojana is as follows:-
(i) Khata No. 114, Plot No. 11, area 195' X 15' = 2925 Sq. feet (approx. 6.70 Patna High Court CWJC No.14927 of 2022(4) dt.07-05-2024 decimals).
(ii) Khata No. 114, Plot No. 12, area 545' X 15' = 8175 Sq. feet (approx. 18.75 decimals).
(iii) Khata No. 114, Plot No. 200' X 12' = 2400 Sq. feet (approx. 5.5 decimals).
A total sum of area is 13,500 Sq.
feet (approx. 30.95 decimals of land) out of 22 acres of entire land."
5. A counter-affidavit has been filed by the respondents which include the Collector, Gaya as also the District Land Acquisition Officer, Gaya and Circle Officer, Manpur, Gaya and again, its paragraph-5 read as follows:
"5.
That it is humbly submitted that neither any land was required for Namami Ganga Priyojna/Udhaw Ganga Priyojana in Mauza- Kukra.

P.S. - Buniyadiganj, Dist.
- Gaya nor any land was acquired in the said Mauza nor any construction has been made with respect to said project over the impugned land and as such, the present writ application is liable to be rejected on this ground also."
6.

This counter-affidavit was filed in the month of Patna High Court CWJC No.14927 of 2022(4)
dt.07-05-2024 January, 2024 and no reply/rejoinder to it has been filed by the petitioner.
In the aforesaid background, this Court is convinced with the stand of the State that the land of the petitioner has not been used for the Namami Ganga Pariyojana/Udhaw Ganga Priyojana.

However,
learned Senior counsel insists that it indeed has been used.

It is his submission that the petitioner is ready to get it inquired as to whether the pipes have been placed inside land or not and is further ready to pay Rs. 10,000/- (as cost of the inquiry to be held by the respondents) through Demand Draft addressed in the name of the Collector, Gaya.

He submits that in case, the inquiry report goes against the stand of the petitioner, the amount so given be forfeited but if his charges are found true,
it be returned.

sentences.text:
7. Learned State counsel on the other hand stands by the paragraph-5 and submits that even today,
he telephonically talked to the concerned respondents and they asserted that the land of the petitioner has not been used for Namami Ganga Project and no underground pipes have been used on the land in question.

8. In that background, when the petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 10,000/- by way of demand draft and if the inquiry goes against him to get it forfeited, the matter is adjourned for Patna High Court CWJC No.14927 of 2022(4) dt.07-05-2024 02.07.2024.

The petitioner shall be submitting the Demand Draft of Rs. 10,000/- within a week to the Office of the respondent no. 2, the Collector,
Gaya.
The Demand Draft be prepared in the name of the Collector, Gaya.

9. Let the Collector, Gaya take cognizance of the matter and constitute an inquiry team headed by the Additional Collector, Gaya and comprising the District Land Acquisition Officer, Gaya as also the Circle Officer, Manpur, Gaya and file a short supplementary counter-affidavit incorporating the said inquiry report.
The Collector, Gaya shall file the affidavit under his own signature and must clearly state whether the pipes have been placed below the land of the petitioner or not.

10. This Court has cautioned learned Senior counsel for the petitioner that if the inquiry report goes against him on the next date of hearing cost shall be imposed as the averment has been made without filing any reply to the counter-affidavit.

11. List this case on 02.07.2024.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
